A BETTER FIRST TRACE

A few things go a long way.

  1. Keep it steady. A fixed camera works best. Fast pans and zooms make detection harder.
  2. Keep it short. Include at least half a second before impact, with the stationary ball visible. One swing, up to 30 seconds.
  3. Let the ball stand out. Good light and a contrasting background help. Either camera angle is supported.
  4. Check the result. This beta uses motion and appearance, not a golf-trained neural model. Use “Adjust the flight” when needed. It won’t invent an unseen landing.
  5. Export in the foreground. Keep this tab visible until the download is ready. Export takes roughly the clip’s duration. Format depends on browser support.
